comparison.objective: Unfold a laptop stand and seat both support rods in the highest-setting slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a passive scissor linkage and independently align two supports into detents.
comparison.success_condition: Stand fully spread, both rods seated in the highest slots, and complete outline inside the taped rectangle.
comparison.reason: Articulated-linkage deployment and detent seating do not require a flush transfer interface, continuous support, or containment of loose rolling elements.
